title: The Shadow That Quit
narration: At two thirteen in the morning, Boro's shadow stepped away from his boots. For years, the little street magician had taken the applause, while his shadow did every difficult trick. It caught falling coins, balanced lanterns, and made impossible birds dance across the walls. Boro bowed after every performance. The shadow never got a single thank-you. Tonight, under the Midnight Market spotlight, it finally refused. It slipped free, strode onto the stage, and performed a dazzling show of its own. The crowd roared. Boro rushed forward to reclaim the attention, tangled his oversized coat, and landed flat on the cobbles. His shadow calmly pointed at a broom. The message was clear: the magician was now the assistant. Boro picked it up. The crowd gave a standing ovation—but every cheer was for the shadow.
